title: Replaying a stored word
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose a mode bit and an input word $x$, an input-head position $p$, words $w$ and $o$, and arbitrary contents and head positions for the other work tapes. Starting with the replay machine's sole tape storing $w$ and its head at $0$, control phase $13$, and output $o$, after $|w|+1$ steps the loop host remains in phase $13$, its tape still stores $w$ with head at position $|w|$, and its output is $o$ followed by $w$; all other specified data are preserved.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
arbitrary contents of the other work tapes
arbitrary head positions of the other work tapes
